notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=1 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or {1} available otherwise.
description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying one mana, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
